evidence.title: GitHub - Openpanel-dev/openpanel: OpenPanel is an open-source web and product analytics platform, an open-source alternative to Mixpanel with optional self-hosting. · GitHub

name: OpenPanel
summary: Open-source web and product analytics platform — funnels, cohorts, session replay, A/B tests and revenue — self-hostable with Docker.
description: An open-source Mixpanel and Google Analytics alternative: event analytics with funnels, cohorts, user profiles, session history, session replay, real-time dashboards, A/B variant breakdowns, event and funnel notifications, revenue tracking and Google Search Console integration. Cookieless and GDPR-focused, with SDKs for web, mobile and server and an MCP server exposing 38 tools to Claude, Cursor and other clients. Self-host with Docker Compose: Next.js dashboard, Fastify event API, Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis, BullMQ, tRPC, Tailwind and shadcn/ui.
contains: features: funnels, cohorts, user profiles, session history, session replay, A/B testing
real-time dashboards, custom charts, event and funnel notifications
cookieless tracking and GDPR compliance; web, mobile and server-side SDKs
revenue tracking of purchases, subscriptions and LTV; Google Search Console integration
MCP server: 38 tools for Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients
stack: Next.js, Fastify, Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis, BullMQ, tRPC, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
self-hosting via Docker Compose; dashboard on port 3000, API on 3333, Bullboard queue UI
